title: Sewing on Thin Groupoids, Knitting, and Based Holonomy for Lipschitz Paths
summary: An approximate action of the pair groupoid of a metric space determines an action of its Lipschitz-thin groupoid on complete extended metric fibers, uniquely characterized by its local sewing estimate. We prove this assertion under a superlinear three-point defect estimate and a Lipschitz bound for finite products. As a result, we obtain a positive proof of Curry and Manchon's sewing conjecture [2], with the necessary path-scaling correction to its estimate.
